name: Nuclei
what: A fast open-source scanner that runs YAML templates against URLs and hosts to detect known vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
when: To check your own web-facing assets for newly published issues quickly, or to automate checks in a pipeline.
example: Run against one approved target: `nuclei -u https://app.contoso.com`.
Narrow the run to the most important templates: `nuclei -u https://app.contoso.com -severity critical,high`.
Verify each hit manually and create tickets only for confirmed findings.
pitfalls: Community templates vary in quality; confirm findings before you escalate.
Some templates send active requests; never point it at systems you do not own.
